{{Quote|Target the craft called the Nomannic, a Corellian transport|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Nomannic''''' was a standard [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] civilian [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] passing through a customs checkpoint. It was the first [[Starship/Legends|craft]] of several to be inspected by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Watch as the Nomannic flies through its flight path|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
The Nomannic was a standard [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] that was white in color. It was lightly armed with a gun turret for use in self-defense if attacked.

==History==
{{Quote|It bears a cargo of Spice as its manifest claims, so it may go.|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was present at an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs checkpoint and flew a small path ending in front of a stationary [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] "Gamma 1." The [[TIE series|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was ordered to target the [[Starship/Legends|craft]] and keep it in the [[Combat Multi-view Display]] and to watch as it flew slowly reaching the fighter's sensors. The ship's cargo was scanned to contain [[Spice/Legends|spice]], matching its manifest, so it was allowed to leave. The fighter was then ordered to inspect the other ships surrounding the customs checkpoint, including the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] [[StarTour 7|''Startour 7'']]; two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]], ''[[Seinar T4D]]'' and ''[[Seinar T5D]]''; the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Elorac]]''; and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Ritam]]''. Meanwhile, the ''Nomannic'' entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The ''Nomannic''{{'s}} actions were recorded as part of a [[Combat chamber|training]] [[Simulation room|simulation]] used to train future pilots, including [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nomannic'' first appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[1994]] PC game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. Its only appearance was in the Combat chamber's first TIE Interceptor training mission, "Threat Dispay." The craft is coded "Blue" in the [[Combat Multi-view Display]], indicating "Neutral" and that the ship must be inspected as part of a "Primary" objective, which is to inspect all the ships in the area.

Interestingly enough, the ''Nomannic'' also appears in the sequel to ''TIE Fighter'', ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'', in the training mission "Inspection", which is an almost exact replica of the Combat chamber mission. Unlike in ''TIE Fighter'', not only can the player pilot any Imperial Fighter in the training mission, but the player can also play as a Rebel fighter and the game treats the scenario as its Rebel Territory. The transport performs the exact role down to its cargo being "spices."
